card.title: IT Quality Senior Manager, Test Automation - Vice President
card.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The IT Quality Senior Manager accomplishes results through the management of professional team(s) and department(s). Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Contributes to standards around which others will operate. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the entire function. Requires basic commercial awareness. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Has responsibility for volume, quality, timeliness and delivery of end results of an area. May have responsibility for planning, budgeting and policy formulation within area of expertise. Involved in short-term planning resource planning. Full management responsibility of a team, which may include management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary and terminations and may include budget approval.
 
 
**Responsibilities:**

* Performs initiatives related to User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process and product rollout into production. Testing specialists who work with technology project managers, UAT professionals and users to design and implement appropriate scripts/plans for an application testing strategy/approach. Responsibilities may also include software quality assurance testing.
* Manages multiple IT Quality teams or an IT Quality functional area (depending on size of business).
* Resolves complex and highly variable issues.
* Analyzes trends at an organizational level to improve processes; follows and analyzes industry trends.
* Develops and designs standards and procedures; ensures that they are adhered to throughout the software development life cycle.
* Manages organizational process change.
* Develops and implements methods for cost, effort and milestones of IT Quality activities. Strives for continuous improvements and streamlining of processes.
* Ensures consistency and quality of processes across the organization. Exhibits in-depth understanding of concepts and procedures within own area and basic knowledge of these elements in other areas.
* Requires in-depth understanding of how own area integrates within IT Quality and has basic commercial awareness.
* Evaluates subordinates' performance and makes decisions on pay increases, promotions, terminations, etc.
* Uses evaluative judgment in complicated or novel situations; uses multiple sources of information.
* Impacts IT Quality through delivery of end results and contribution to planning, finances/budget and formulation of policies.
* Responsible for budgeting, project estimates, task management & balancing prioritization across multiple streams of development
* Responsible for people management, mentoring and career development process for Shanghai team including delivering performance review, training, recruiting.
* Collaborates with local and global stakeholders like QA team, production support team, environment management team, DBA team, etc. to ensure project stability and productivity.
* Responsible for handling day-to-day staff management issues, including resource management and allocation of work within the team/project.
* Performs other duties and functions as assigned.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
* Playwright & TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery (Required): Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* CI/CD Pipeline Integration & Quality Gating (Required): In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including setting up automated regression triggering and pipeline hard gating.
* Containerization & Scaled Infrastructure (Strongly Preferred): Strong background in leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to containerize test suites and horizontally scale distributed test execution across enterprise environments.
* GenAI & Agentic Testing Workflows (Strongly Preferred): Experience using AI Harnesses (e.g., GitHub Copilot or Claude) and creating custom AI agents or automated agentic workflows to optimize the software testing lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

 
 

* Extensive hands-on experience designing and building scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.

* In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including automated regression triggering and pipeline gating.

* 6 to 10 years of IT testing experience, with excellent knowledge of software testing techniques and tools.

* Working knowledge of established software development and testing lifecycle methodologies.

* Full people management experience, including performance evaluation, hiring, and career development.

* Strong communication and diplomacy skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders across functions.

* An automation-first mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to test development.

**Education:**

 
 
 

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

card.title: Director of Quality Improvement & Corporate Compliance
card.description:
Description:

**Help strengthen the quality, integrity, and impact of behavioral healthcare.**

Monadnock Family Services (MFS) is seeking an experienced, thoughtful, and collaborative **Director of Quality Improvement and Corporate Compliance** to provide organization-wide leadership for quality improvement, regulatory compliance, and organizational accountability.

This is an important opportunity for someone who believes quality improvement should be more than audits and reports. At MFS, this position will help turn data, feedback, and identified concerns into meaningful improvements that strengthen services, protect consumer rights, support employees, and promote organizational effectiveness.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Director will work closely with executive leadership, program directors, clinical leaders, and the Board of Directors to ensure that quality and compliance are integrated into the way the organization operates.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead Quality Improvement**

* Direct the agency's quality improvement program and establish meaningful measures of organizational and program performance.
* Analyze performance data, audit findings, consumer feedback, and service outcomes to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with program leaders to develop, implement, and evaluate quality improvement initiatives and corrective action plans.
* Report quality findings, organizational trends, and improvement progress to executive leadership and the Board.

**Oversee Corporate Compliance**

* Develop, maintain, and monitor the agency's Corporate Compliance Plan.
* Monitor compliance with applicable federal and New Hampshire regulations, licensing standards, payer requirements, and contractual obligations.
* Coordinate the review of potential compliance concerns and support appropriate investigations and corrective actions.
* Communicate regulatory changes and compliance expectations to agency leadership.

**Strengthen Consumer Rights and Risk Management**

* Oversee the agency's complaint and grievance processes and serve as an escalation resource for complex or sensitive concerns.
* Lead the critical incident review process and monitor trends, recommendations, and follow-through.
* Work with clinical and program leadership to identify risks and implement strategies that improve safety and service quality.

**Support Documentation, Privacy, and Regulatory Readiness**

* Oversee clinical recordkeeping standards and quality monitoring activities.
* Support agency compliance with HIPAA and applicable confidentiality requirements.
* Coordinate preparation for licensing reviews, audits, accreditation activities, and external monitoring.
* Support staff education related to documentation, privacy, compliance, incident reporting, and consumer rights.

**Lead and Develop the Quality Improvement Team**

* Supervise and develop Quality Improvement staff, including the Complaint Manager and Medical Records Specialist.
* Establish clear expectations, priorities, and performance standards.
* Promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous professional development.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate brings a combination of analytical ability, regulatory knowledge, leadership experience, and sound professional judgment. They are comfortable examining complex issues, asking difficult questions, and working collaboratively to develop practical solutions.

Requirements:

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a clinical, behavioral health, healthcare administration, public health, business administration, or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Demonstrated experience in quality improvement, corporate compliance, healthcare administration, behavioral health operations, or a related field.
* Experience interpreting and applying regulatory, licensing, contractual, or payer requirements.
* Experience developing or monitoring quality improvement initiatives, performance measures, audits, or corrective action plans.
* Experience supervising employees or leading cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a Community Mental Health Center or other regulated healthcare setting.
* Familiarity with New Hampshire behavioral health regulations and licensing requirements.
* Experience with accreditation, external audits, regulatory reviews, or compliance program administration.
* Training or experience in quality improvement methodologies such as PDSA, Lean, Six Sigma, or root cause analysis.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means building a quality and compliance program that is active, useful, and respected throughout the organization. The Director will help ensure that:

* Quality measures inform decisions and lead to measurable improvements.
* Compliance concerns are identified, appropriately addressed, and monitored through resolution.
* Complaints and critical incidents result in meaningful review and follow-through.
* Leadership and the Board receive clear, timely information about organizational performance and risk.
* Program leaders and employees understand their shared responsibility for quality and compliance.

**Why Join Monadnock Family Services?**

MFS is committed to providing timely access to safe, high-quality, results-driven, and sustainable mental healthcare for our communities rooted in best practices, respect, and compassion.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute at an organizational level, work directly with senior leadership, and help shape the systems and practices that support quality behavioral healthcare throughout the communities we serve.

If you are a strategic thinker who values accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we invite you to consider joining our team.

**Apply today to be part of the work that strengthens behavioral healthcare in our communities.**

Monadnock Family Services is an equal opportunity employer.

card.title: Director of Mobile Operations - Skilled Trades
card.description:
**Job Title: Director of Mobile Operations - Skilled Trades**

**Department:** Operations / Field Services

**Reports To:** Chief Operating Officer (COO)

Are you a skilled trades leader ready to take your career beyond managing the day-to-day? At **TDG Facilities**, we're building something exceptional, and we're looking for a leader who wants to be part of it. If you're passionate about the trades, energized by developing talented people, and motivated by the opportunity to shape a growing organization, we want to meet you. This isn't just another management position. It's an opportunity to bring your expertise, influence how we operate, build a team you're proud of, and play a meaningful role in our future. **If you're ready to lead, grow, and make your mark, let's talk.**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Director of Mobile Operations - Skilled Trades is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational performance, and continuous improvement of all skilled trades field service teams across the organization (electrical, plumbing, HVAC). This role oversees multiple technicians and technical leads and is accountable for service delivery (KPI), workforce utilization, financial performance, safety compliance, customer satisfaction, and operational standardization across all mobile service lines. This is a critical role heavily involved in overseeing service delivery expectations in each of the skilled trades disciplines.

The Director ensures that the electrical, plumbing, and HVAC teams consistently deliver high-quality, compliant, and cost-effective IFM services while aligning field operations with company growth objectives, service standards, and technology platforms. Success in this role will be measured by: mobile team utilization and productivity; delivery efficiency; quality; SLA compliance; safety performance and incident reduction; budget adherence and margin performance; workforce retention and development; operational consistency across regions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Leadership**

* Work closely with Account management teams for client expectations and problem solving
* Provide direct leadership to all skilled trades technicians, technical leads, and service coordination
* Standardize mobile service delivery processes, SOPs, and performance expectations across all markets.
* Ensure consistent execution of preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and on-demand services.
* Support the development of repair estimates in each of the skilled trades disciplines with support from senior mobile technicians
* Drive operational discipline in scheduling, dispatching, documentation, and close-out procedures

**Workforce & Resource Management**

* Optimize technician utilization, service quality, and labor productivity.
* Oversee workforce planning, staffing levels, skill coverage, and training programs.
* Ensure proper certification, licensing, and competency alignment for all mobile technicians.

* Coordination engagement with field technicians for continuity of workflow

**Financial & Performance Management**

* Monitor KPIs including response times, first-time fix rates, utilization, backlog, and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure that all service and repair quotes are delivered on time as committed to meet TDG quality expectations
* Identify cost-reduction opportunities while maintaining service quality.

**Customer & Account Support**

* Serve as an escalation point for technical service issues in electrical, plumbing, and HVAC services
* Partner with departmental stakeholders to ensure service alignment.

**Safety, Compliance & Risk**

* Enforce safety programs, training, and field compliance standards.
* Ensure adherence to OSHA, NFPA, local codes, and contractual requirements.

**Technology & Process Improvement**

* Champion the use of Field Service System for notes, time, and documentation related to service work orders
* Drive adoption of mobile tools, asset data standards, and reporting dashboards.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, and visibility.

**Direct Reports**

* Skilled Trades supervisors and superintendants

* Operations coordination (co-managed)

**Required Qualifications**

* 4-7+ years of experience in facilities management, field service, construction services, or similar operational environments
* 5+ years in a senior leadership role managing multi-site or mobile operations
* Strong understanding of IFM service lines (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, general maintenance, etc.)
* Proven experience leading managers and large technician workforces
* Financial acumen with labor cost control and operational budgeting
* Experience with FSS systems and mobile workforce platforms
* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or related field
* Lean, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence training
* Experience in scaling mobile service teams in a growing company

**Core Competencies**

* Technical Service Management
* Project / Repair / Construction Estimation Competency
* Operations Leadership
* Workforce Optimization
* Financial Management
* Safety & Compliance
* Customer Relationship Management
* Process Standardization
* Change Management
* Technology Enablement

**tdgFacilities is full-service facilities management company based in Cincinnati, OH with over 6M square feet under management in OH, IN, KY, TN, GA, AL & FL. We work together to go above and beyond to ensure that our clients are proud of their environment. Our clients include, Fortune 500 companies, healthcare facilities, public and private schools, private investor groups and municipalities.**

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
